1.en_consolidated_definition:
To eat. Pay and take it away. Wholesale and retail trade in which the customer purchases goods for cash.

Commercial establishment selling goods in bulk or by the piece, where the client pays immediately upon taking delivery. Raw Anglicism, commonly used. Immediately following is CIU 5411, food stores (colmados, supermarkets, and cash-and-carry), representing 14.6%, compared to the other 19 classifications (Company of Commerce and )
